$comment: Reviewed NeXus mapping for one instrument. Rows are nexus-design-studio FieldMapping rows -- the same shape as its instrument-profile schema -- so they can be handed back to NDS as a profile. 'source' is ours: the path inside this instrument's detector group holding the value, which is what gets linked. A row with no source is a decision with nothing to point at yet. Edited here or in the review app's Formats tab.
$instrumentId: The DRACO instrument catalogue's id for this instrument (NDS catalogs/instruments/hzdr-draco.yaml, hzdr-draco 0.2.0). 'catalogue': the catalogue has the entry. 'proposed': it does not yet, and the id is the catalogue's slug rule applied to the folder label, for the maintainer to add or correct.
$status: 'proposed' means NDS suggested these and nobody has checked them: they are recorded, shown in the app pre-filled, and DELIBERATELY NOT written into any container. 'reviewed' means a person went through them, and only then do they change the data.

lowConfidence: NDS confidence is low or advice was unavailable

reconciliations.why: phase 2a of HZDR_combo planning/NEXUS_OUTPUT_PLAN.md (decision 5): keyed by the catalogue's instrument.id and held to the NDS profile
reconciliations.note: NXxrd_pan is not named by profiles/beam_profiler.yaml (it names none); rows kept, moved out of the NXsubentry the claim made

reconciliations.why: hzdr-draco 0.2.0 lists this id; the status follows the vendored catalogue

mappings.note: Recovered from the file name; the export records no timezone, so the profile's `timezone:` above supplies it and NXDL gets the timezone-aware ISO8601 it types NX_DATE_TIME as. A value already carrying an offset is left alone.
The trailing counter in the file name, distinguishing frames captured within one second. NXdetector declares `sequence_number`.
No seed mapping found; documented as custom field for review. AUTO DEFAULT: LOW CONFIDENCE

The captured frame itself, read from the sibling `<stem>_original.png` at apply time. NXdetector/data is where NXDL puts a detector's array, and the group must stay `detector_<something>` because NXDL declares detector_TYPE with nameType="partial". The applier stamps `interpretation=image` on rank-2 data, so a viewer opening the array knows it is a picture rather than a line.

FALSE FRIEND CORRECTED. The matcher reads `source` as the beam source and sends this to /entry/instrument/source/. It is the *input* end of the contrast tool's level stretch (0..3158 a.u. mapped onto 0..65535), a display transform applied to the captured image.
See contrast.min_source — same false friend, same correction.
65535 says the stretch targets a 16-bit range. Deliberately not mapped to NXdetector/bit_depth_readout: that is the sensor's readout depth, which this does not establish.

FALSE FRIEND CORRECTED. The matcher sends this to /entry/instrument/detector/data because `_head_token` strips `number` as a form-word, leaving `image` as the head noun — so a frame counter lands on the detector's data array. NXdetector declares `frame_start_number` for exactly this.

The file's `Name` row (e.g. acA2040-35gm). NXfabrication/model is the better NeXus concept for a device model, but NXfabrication has no base_class_paths entry, so the builder cannot place it — see the held_back note in the review artifact. NXdetector/description is declared and placeable, and is where this goes until that is resolved.
NXDL spells a detector's integration time `count_time`, not `exposure_time` — the same rename the spectrometer profiles make.
Declared by NXdetector. Recorded in dB as the camera reports it.
Camera black-level offset. NXdetector declares no black-level or pedestal field; kept custom and documented rather than forced. AUTO DEFAULT: LOW CONFIDENCE
Camera gamma. No NXDL equivalent; kept custom. AUTO DEFAULT: LOW CONFIDENCE

Physical sensor extent. NXdetector declares x_pixel_size (per pixel) and sensor_thickness, but no sensor width — those are different quantities, so this stays custom rather than being written into a field that means something else. AUTO DEFAULT: LOW CONFIDENCE
See chip_size_x. AUTO DEFAULT: LOW CONFIDENCE

Injected by this profile as a site constant. NXfabrication/vendor is the right NeXus concept and is unreachable for the same reason as the model (no base_class_paths entry), so the row is here to make that a recorded decision rather than an accident of the field having no hint. AUTO DEFAULT: LOW CONFIDENCE
